It was an amazingly beautiful wedding if I so say so myself. The weather was a bit precarious. A
storm rolled in right before we were supposed to start. It was sprinkling when I walked down the
aisle, and during the ceremony, but it wasn't bad. Then the sun came out right as we finished and
lit the mountains beautifully. It stayed clear just long enough to get photos, then as soon as we
were in the tent, torrential downpour! Right after ceremony, there was a full rainbow with the
house right in the middle. Pretty cool. Thank you for everything. You were definitely missed, but
I understand.
